Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Monthly band: based on usage projections we expect a steady-state band closer to 4M–5M tokens/month. We do expect short spikes to ~7–8M during heavy experimentation windows, but average should be in that 4–5M corridor.
- Budget per 1M: target is closer to $700–$900 / 1M depending on discount/commit. We prefer a blended, predictable rate rather than per-call variability.
- PO threshold: Procurement typically requires PO >= $50k for external platforms; below that they will push for an internal card or a smaller contract. That means the pilot PO will likely need to be $50k+ to go through procurement.
- Timeline: procurement lead times ~3–4 weeks once we have SOW + quote. Elaine is the procurement lead — Elaine, is that still accurate?

Samir / Elaine — really helpful, thanks. See a concise proposal below and attached pricing matrix & draft SOW for procurement.

Proposal (options based on confirmed 4M–5M expected):
1) Pilot (no commit): pay-as-you-go — $950 / 1M tokens, monthly invoices. PO not required for proof-of-concept under $50k.
2) Pilot with short commit (recommended): 3-month commitment at 4M/month average (12M total) — effective $850 / 1M. Invoice monthly, PO for pilot recommended at $10k–$25k depending on the internal approval lane you prefer.
3) Production commit (preferred for predictable unit economics): 12-month commit @ 5M/month — base $800 / 1M. If you sign a 12-month commit we can offer a further 10% volume discount after month 6 and include a clause for automatic model fallback to a lower-cost model if monthly usage exceeds the commit by >20% (to protect unit economics). Requires PO >= $50k for first invoice to satisfy procurement lanes you mentioned.

Key procurement items to confirm:
- Preferred PO breakpoint (you mentioned $50k typical) — confirm whether pilot can be routed via the $50k lane or you want us to structure a smaller initial PO.
- Net terms: We default to Net30 for committed contracts; we can offer Net45 for enterprise with legal approval, or Net15 for pilot. Let us know preference.

Attachments (attached to this thread): redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx — shows tiered $/1M for the models we discussed and commit ladders; SOW-Brightline-v1.pdf — draft SOW with deliverables and security appendix.
